manifest.description: Authenticated Prompt 10 evidence and preregistered combination readiness

blocks.body:
# Prompt 11 baseline results audit

Authenticated individual-selector evidence and outcome-blind combination readiness.

## Audit result

All 36 frozen baseline cells authenticated complete. All 396 supported saved-prediction metric checks reconciled, with zero discrepancies. The completed matrix contains 36 locked OOT evaluation units.

## Evidence boundary

All results come from authenticated Prompt 10 artifacts. OOT paired inference is supported; DEV fold prediction inference is not, because fold prediction vectors were not persisted.

## Scoped paired OOT comparisons

Exact deltas, paired bootstrap intervals, Holm-adjusted p-values, count comparability, and conservative evidence labels are shown together. Non-significance is not equivalence.

## DEV temporal robustness

Each row summarizes five ordered expanding-window folds without pooling.

## Runtime and resources

Active computation, RAM waiting, peak RSS, and minimum available RAM are feasibility evidence only.

## Limitations and next step

Fold predictions and score-PSI bin edges were not persisted. Natural-support shortfalls are not method failures. The next scientific step is the unchanged 24-evaluation pilot backed by 18 unique selection identities; DEV and OOT remain gated.
